# Requirements Analysis

Use this skill when turning unstructured input into a standard requirement document.

## Procedure

1. Capture the raw input exactly.
2. Identify stakeholders, personas, goals, non-goals, and constraints.
3. Convert capabilities into stable requirement IDs.
4. Write functional requirements with actor, trigger, behavior, outcome, priority, and dependencies.
5. Write non-functional requirements for performance, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, observability, and support.
6. Create testable acceptance criteria.
7. Build a traceability matrix from goals to requirements to acceptance criteria.
8. Put uncertain points into assumptions or open questions.

Use the main template: [requirement document template](../../../templates/requirement-document.md).
